confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Mérida, not from inspected listings or live prices. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain and may vary by neighbourhood and season. Cocktail and wine were estimated directly but are consistent with the local beer price (about 2.5 times beer). The FX observation could not be opened directly on rba.gov.au; the 2026-10-15 value comes from a search summary attributing it to the RBA, so verify it against the RBA F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other mid-sized Mexican colonial cities with tourism and expat demand, such as Oaxaca and Puebla, priced below Mexico City, Cancún and Tulum. No web search was used for the city-price anchors.
